title: AWS CI script hardcodes ~/WORK/WOLFKM path; other contributors cannot use it
description: tests/ci/test-on-aws.sh hardcodes WOLFKM_ROOT=${HOME}/WORK/WOLFKM with no env-var override and no useful error message when absent. The file is checked into the wolfssl repo and will appear in any clone, but TEST_CRYPTO2DEV=1 will silently proceed then fail or succeed vacuously if that path is absent. Scenario: a contributor or CI runner clones the repo, runs TEST_CRYPTO2DEV=1, gets a confusing failure unrelated to the code under test. Maintenance consequence: CI script is not reusable by anyone other than the original author as-is.
